survey_leads.text: govinfo holds the LSA 1986-2000 compilation as LSA-COMP-1986-2000-vol1 to vol4 (zips of 2.7 to 5.4 MB at https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/<id>.zip, no key). Found by the keyed API listing; the year sitemaps do not list them. Listed in the manifest, not read in this run.

The Library of Congress holds sample LSA items for 1971-1982. The LOC CFR and LSA scans come from HeinOnline under a stated term against bulk download; the owner has not decided on them. Listed, never bulk-fetched by this job.
The Internet Archive has the 1973-1985 LSA volumes (see the internet_archive rows). No complete pre-1997 LSA run was found by the survey.

The Federal Register's own Codification Guide (the CFR Parts Affected tables) sits inside the FR issues; govinfo has the Federal Register for 1936-2026 with no key (sitemaps and issue PDFs). Not read here.
HathiTrust babel /cgi/ pages are robots-disallowed for generic agents: no page text is scraped.
